chunks: My father narrated, may God be pleased with him, said be pleased with him, who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Yaqoob ibn Yazid, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The minimum that suffices of the Takbir in turning towards the prayer is one Takbir, and three Takbirs, and five and seven are better.
And I have explained the reason for the seven Takbirs in the Opening in my book 'Ilal al-Shara'i' wa al-Ahkam wa al-Asbab.

key_terms.عِلَلِ الشَّرَائِعِ: Reasons for the Laws (title of a book)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and recommended number of Takbirs before starting the prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq establishes a flexible legal hierarchy for the opening Takbirs, distinguishing between the minimum validity (one) and the recommended perfection (seven), reflecting the Shia emphasis on following the Imams' specific practices. He references his work *'Ilal al-Shara'i'* to provide the underlying wisdom (*'ill*) for the number seven, linking ritual form to deeper theological significance. This ruling underscores the distinction between mere obligation and the preferred manner of worship as taught by Imam al-Sadiq.
